i.norm: Verifies how a {@link SimpleBloomFilter} reports {@link BloomFilter#cardinality()} and {@link BloomFilter#isEmpty()} as individual bits are merged in and then cleared.
Number of hash functions (k) for the test filter's shape.
Number of bits (m) for the test filter's shape.
The shape shared by every filter in this test.

A freshly created filter must report itself as empty with zero cardinality. Setting one bit at a time must grow the cardinality by exactly one per bit, and the filter must stop being empty after the first bit is set. After a {@link BloomFilter#clear()} the filter must return to its empty state, and the same growth behaviour must hold again.
A brand new filter holds no bits.
Setting each bit in turn raises the cardinality by one and leaves the filter non-empty.
Clearing resets the filter back to empty with zero cardinality.
Repeat the growth check, asserting cardinality before emptiness this time.
